info.title: Governance bounded support access
info.description: Policy version 1: explicitly scoped membership/grant diagnostics; independent tenant/security approval; current online owner admission. No impersonation, secrets, native writes or offline identity fallback. Server-to-server Console ingress only; do not expose workload/session headers to browsers. API-first workflow; no Console support screen is claimed.
